orientation.what_matters_now: The Hall reports 30 occupied ICU beds and two available physical beds, but the roster safely covers approximately 28 and the two empty places do not have a complete staffed team.

desire.wants: An ICU pathway for a newly stabilized patient.

friction: ICU has two physical beds but no safely staffed place; every clinically governed alternative transfers pressure to emergency care, another hospital service, or the regional network.
turn: The responsible clinicians define eligibility and minimum safety, so the player influences which system carries the pressure rather than placing the patient in an empty bed without a safe team.
residue: The patient has a named responsible clinical team and a defined location or accepted transfer; the hospital has not created new capacity, but has placed the cost elsewhere.
begins_after: Stable supply returns or the failed board is safely isolated, no permanent harm is identified, and the outage has consumed people and equipment that might have created temporary margin.
ends_before: The transferred pressure on emergency care, a donor service, or the regional network is relieved.
